attempts.why: Later .btn{display:inline-flex} overrides .menu-toggle{display:none} due to source order/equal specificity, so the menu toggle incorrectly shows at 1200px; raising specificity fixes it.

selfVerify.reason: Menu toggle is hidden at 1200px width as intended (no hamburger icon visible, header shows full nav Pricing/Docs/Blog/Careers/Support), so the .btn override bug is resolved. No other obvious layout breakage: hero text, filter buttons, and 3-column product cards render normally at 1200x800.
